## History

Seven years prior to Nell's arrival at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), Tranter transported [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) from [Hopetown](../codex/places.md#hopetown). Years later, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) brought [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to visit Tranter in [Pale Sands](../codex/places.md#pale-sands-hotel) in order to arrange Nell's return to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) due to a mix-up regarding her adoption. However, after encountering another woman who offered to take [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) delayed the decision and took [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) back home instead.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P0](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P14](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P35](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P40](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind P18](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0018), +3 more_

## Relationships

### [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/thirza-abernethy--tranter.md)

Tranter is an acquaintance of [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) whom [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) visits to consult on matters regarding orphan placement. When [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) brings [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to Tranter's home to arrange the girl's return to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) following an adoption mix-up, another woman offers to take [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) instead. Unwilling to leave [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) with that woman, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) delays her decision and ultimately decides to keep the child herself.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P0](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P14](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IV. Morning at Grey Shutters P35](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0035), +5 more_

- Friend of — acquaintances visiting and consulting on orphan placement  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Thirza Makes Up Her Mind P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003)</sub>
